entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need some help with an order. I bought an Aero Race Jersey a while back and it's just not working for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I'd like to start a return if possible.
Thank you. I see the order here. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me a bit more? Is there a technical fault with the jersey, or is it more of a preference or fit issue?
It’s a fit issue. I ordered my usual size, but this specific jersey is just too tight. It seems I got the wrong size for this particular cut.

I understand completely. Our race-fit items can be quite snug. Let me just check your delivery date... okay, I see it was delivered 68 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you.
Oh, that’s great news. I was a bit worried I'd waited too long. So, I can just send the jersey back for a full refund?
That's correct. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes.

Excellent, thank you. Now, since I do want to get the correct size, I'll be placing a new order. Given the trouble of having to make an exchange, would it be possible to get a small discount code to apply to the new purchase?

I'm glad I could help you with the return. While I'm not able to provide a discount code for a sizing issue, I can certainly point you to our sizing guide which has detailed measurements to ensure the next jersey you order has the perfect fit.
Alright, that's fair. I appreciate you processing the return so quickly. I'll look for that email. Thanks for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Have a good day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
